description: Implement merge completion recording in Evolution Tracker for learning from past merges
workflow_rationale: Single focused feature adding merge completion tracking to existing FileEvolutionTracker

phases.name: Add Merge Completion Data Models
phases.description: Create data models for merge completion records

subtasks.description: Create MergeCompletionRecord dataclass in file_evolution module
subtasks.notes: Add dataclass at top of tracker.py with fields: merge_id, timestamp, task_ids, resolved_files, success, error

phases.name: Add Tracker Methods
phases.description: Add methods to FileEvolutionTracker for merge completion recording

subtasks.notes: Implemented record_merge_completion method with merge_id generation, MergeCompletionRecord creation, and persistence to merge_history.json
Implemented get_merge_completion_history method that returns list of MergeCompletionRecord objects, with optional filtering by task_id and limit parameters

phases.name: Add Storage Persistence
phases.description: Update EvolutionStorage to persist merge completion data

subtasks.description: Add merge_completions.json file handling to EvolutionStorage
subtasks.notes: Added load_merge_completions and save_merge_completions methods following existing storage patterns. Implementation creates merge_completions.json file and follows same pattern as load_merge_history/save_merge_history.

Implemented _record_merge_completion function that calls FileEvolutionTracker.record_merge_completion with task_ids=[spec_name], resolved_files, and success=True. Added error handling and debug logging. Removed from 'remaining functions' comment at top of file.

subtasks.description: Uncomment and activate _record_merge_completion call in merge_existing_build
subtasks.notes: Uncommented lines 1637-1638 in _resolve_git_conflicts_with_ai to activate merge completion recording after successful merge. Function is now called with project_dir, spec_name, and resolved_files.

phases.name: Testing and Verification
phases.description: Verify merge completion recording works end-to-end

subtasks.description: Create test for merge completion recording
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive test suite with 27 tests covering MergeCompletionRecord dataclass, record_merge_completion, get_merge_completion_history, and persistence across sessions. All tests passing.

subtasks.description: Verify merge completion data persists across sessions

verification.instructions: Run a merge, verify merge_completions.json is created in .auto-claude/file_evolution/, check it contains merge record

subtasks.notes: Manual verification that merge completions persist to disk and can be loaded after restart

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution - each phase depends on previous

acceptance_criteria: Merge completion data is recorded to .auto-claude/file_evolution/merge_completions.json
FileEvolutionTracker has record_merge_completion and get_merge_completion_history methods
_record_merge_completion function is implemented and called in merge workflow
Merge completion history can be retrieved for learning from past merges

verification_steps.name: Import Verification
verification_steps.command: python -c "from apps.backend.merge.file_evolution.tracker import FileEvolutionTracker, MergeCompletionRecord; from apps.backend.core.workspace import _record_merge_completion; print('All imports OK')"

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk feature adding new functionality without modifying existing behavior. Unit tests sufficient for verification.
